newsitem.title: JAPAN: Dec Euroyen futures rise 0.1 to 98.89 after data.
newsitem.headline: Dec Euroyen futures rise 0.1 to 98.89 after data.

text.p: The key December Euroyen futures contract briefly rose to 98.89, a rise of 0.1, in Thursday afternoon Tokyo trade after the release of weaker-than-expected April industrial production data.
April industrial output fell a preliminary 0.4 percent from the previous month on a seasonally adjusted basis, the Ministry of International Trade and Industry (MITI) said on Thursday.
The Trade Ministry had expected major manufacturers' output to show a 0.3 percent rise.
Manufacturers' output is forecast to rise 2.7 percent month-on-month in May and to fall 1.9 percent in June, MITI said.
Although the key December contract soon slipped from its highs, it remained firmer, trading at 98.84 at mid-afternoon against a Wednesday settlement of 98.79.
